rustTimingBoundary: P0 technical/stats retain actual Rust timing boundaries; P1/Memory provide no separate Rust timer, null is unmeasured. End-to-end always includes full product validation and two-frame initial paint.

display.browserRenderer: Recorded by each actual browser sample

hostStart.boundary: Read-only conditions at collection time. Active display identity is the QueryDisplayConfig source/target adapter LUID and ID path, not an EDID serial. Pixel dimensions come from source desktop and target signal active modes, not CSS viewport or millimetres. Per-sample viewport/focus/renderer are separate. Other user applications were not closed or inspected; no claim that every host process is idle. CurrentRefreshRate is rounded; rational activeRefreshRates are authoritative for this snapshot. Endpoint snapshots alone cannot exclude transient changes that return to the same state between captures.

qualification.boundary: Both recorded endpoints must satisfy the reference machine, AC power, Balanced GUID and approximately 60 Hz, and preserve the active source/target adapter-ID display paths, physical pixel dimensions and exact rational refresh rates. Display identity is an adapter path, not an EDID serial. Two matching endpoints alone cannot exclude transient changes between captures, prove an idle OS, physical frame presentation, per-sample foreground state or public hosting.
